imports.modification_summary: Retains exact-HWND WGC capture plus bounded same-window PrintWindow/GDI fallback; removes desktop/display capture, public commands, and caller-selected modes.
imports.authority_delta: Observation pixels only; no input, focus, launch, network, or privilege authority.

imports.modification_summary: Retains bounded read-only UI Automation tree/state observation; removes SetFocus and all mutation/action paths; password values remain unread.

Retains window/process identity, session, COM, geometry, and same-window capture helpers; removes input, PostMessage actuation, focus, activation, and launch; adds protected-process and exact PID/start-generation/window-nonce binding checks.
imports.authority_delta: Read-only process/window facts and capture helpers only.

imports.modification_summary: Uses one-shot sacrificial workers with bounded timeout/retry, scrubbed environment, response binding validation, and fail-closed errors; removes upstream in-process fallback.
imports.authority_delta: Process isolation only; no caller-visible process-launch authority.

imports.modification_summary: Ports only list_windows, observe_window, and capture_window dispatch; launch, activation, auto-launch, and action dispatch are absent.
Lifecycle reference only; no donor MCP server, public CLI catalog, action schema, or input authority is copied.
